tickets.title: Implement bounded concurrent Mesh builds and Pantheon edge
gate_cmd:
import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('docs/mesh-builds')
r=json.loads((p/'profile.json').read_text())
assert r['protocol']=='argo.mesh/1' and r['paid_runs'] is False
assert r['peer_count']==3 and r['application_acceptance']=='external_controller'
for f in r['artifacts']:assert Path(f).is_file(),f
v=json.loads(Path('SYSTEMS/CONTRACT_FREEZE.json').read_text())
for f,h in v['files'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,f
print('PASS offline Mesh packet and unchanged v1 freeze; runtime acceptance is external')
